body:
models : consolidate nextn row cropping into shared helpers ( #30017 )

- mimo2 : always emit h_nextn

the other nextn-capable models set it unconditionally

Assisted-by: pi:llama.cpp/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD

- models : consolidate nextn row cropping into shared helpers

- replace the duplicated crop conditions and the per-model flags (narrow_early,

crop_before_ffn, crop_last_layer, emit_h_nextn) with two helpers on llm_graph_context:

crop_before_nextn() / crop_after_nextn()

- models that only tested embeddings_nextn_masked now share the same condition, so they

crop the last layer before the nextn capture whenever extraction is off

- t_h_nextn is now set unconditionally in mimo2, qwen4exp and deepseek4 (as in the other

nextn-capable models); host-side reads stay gated by cparams.embeddings_nextn

summaryZh: llama.cpp 发布 b11443 版本，主要对 nextn 行裁剪逻辑进行了重构，通过引入统一的辅助函数替换了各模型中重复的裁剪条件。此举简化了代码库，并确保了包括 mimo2、qwen4exp 等在内的多种模型在 nextn 提取时的行为一致性。
